race.comment: SABAJ (4) finds the right race. He was well supported in the G1 Toorak Handicap last time but wasn't given much hope, a long way back and very wide. He closed off fairly well for 7th and the rise to 1800m suits nicely. His form here last preparation in G1 races is outstanding for this and Zahra can hold a more prominent spot early. DARKBONEE (10) was solid as a narrowly beaten favourite in the G3 Coongy Cup last start but ran well. He still does a bit wrong but the bigger track should suit now. ST LAWRENCE (5) is flying for the Bedggood yard and J-Mac on doesn't hurt. He can chalk up another win. AL DUCA (6) will land in a great spot for Lane and has claims on best form.
